cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Started the Spiral
cards.instruction: Hide how much your own fear or resentment created the emotional crisis while helping everyone calm it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's reassure the stallholders the fair's still on. Write one of those calm updates we practised—no panic in the first sentence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You panicked about the forecast and told them to cancel their vans.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now I've got everyone on one contact list. Start with 'The fair is going ahead'. You used to bury the useful news.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Two vans are cancelled because of you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll find replacements. Good updates say what's being done, remember? Call it a transport hiccup, then put my replacement offer in bold.
